title: Prospective Study on Antimicrobial RESIstance in Chronic Pulmonary DiseasE
official: PRESIDE: Prospective Study on Antimicrobial RESIstance in Chronic Pulmonary DiseasE
summary:
This observational, multicentric prospective study aims to understand the prevalence and burden of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in people with chronic lung diseases (CLD) across the globe, understanding also geographical variability and the risk factors for acquiring AMR.

The primary objective is to understand the prevalence and burden of AMR in CLD both at a local and gloval level.

Secondary objectives include: 1) understanding susceptibilities models of high priority pathogens in people with CLD; 2) understanding geographic variability in the prevalence of AMR in CLD; 3) analysing risk factors for AMR in CLD Participants will be recruited
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of all ages with any chronic lung disease who, for clinical practice, underwent testingof at least one respiratory biological sample (sputum culture; bronchoaspirate; bronchoalveolar lavage; nasal swab; throat swab) within the 12 months prior to the visit.
* Patients attending an outpatient clinic or hospitalized during the study period

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have not signed the informed consent form
* Absence of data in the patient record
